description: FIND-006 closure is PARTIAL. PROP-I2-writes-scoped (verification-architecture.md:43) was correctly upgraded to a 3-check (os.stat size + SHA-256 + source grep). Also update the E2E to use ~/gig/earnings.jsonl (the file REQ-I2 primarily protects) — applied.jsonl is a secondary concern.
